Archive a Contract

User manual · English · 9 steps
Learn how to archive a contract that is no longer needed, for example one created by mistake, without losing the payslips linked to it.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Employees menu

Open the Employees menu.

3. Contracts

Click Contracts.

4. Find the contract

Type the name of the contract and press Enter.

5. Open the group

Click the Running group to show its contracts.

6. Select it

Tick the box in front of the contract.

7. Actions

Click Actions.

8. Archive

Click Archive.

9. Confirm

Click Archive in the window to confirm.
